prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original grounded medieval RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART location review concept, elevated three-quarter cutaway. Chunky hard square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained three-tone stone timber linen iron, muted earth palette, no smooth painting or photorealism. No people, no readable text, no quest UI, no magic, no claimed outcome. Modest practical scale, no giant fantasy architecture. Open ordinary return path clearly visible. Geometry is a proposal, not certified collision or inventory. One small paved roadside cooper inspection courtyard at a medieval inn hamlet, outside any wine cellar. Central LOW EMPTY timber barrel inspection cradle, one detached hoop sample on bench has a long gouged maker-line and a separate short new maker-line next to it, both preserved. To the LEFT one low rack with TWO empty older wine barrels and modest dark wine staining around bung. To the RIGHT a physically SEPARATE low rack with TWO plain closed candidate clean-water containers with light linen sealed ties, not automatically certified safe. A small pair of blank red/ochre booking ties attached to the SAME old barrel indicates competing bookings; do not clone barrel for each booking. Open ordinary paved land-return passage behind central stand, short-stay eaves in distance, no visible beds. No person testing by climbing, no drinking, washing or magically purifying barrel, no medical cross, no fulfilled delivery, infinite stock, repayment or authorship erased. Focus inspection and separated potential purposes, not another wine-storage cellar.
